_readme: Lab-level settings for the public site. founded: the year AIMLab started (number) or null to hide the Years Active stat. publications: which years of papers are public ({"mode": "all"} | {"mode": "since", "since": 2020} | {"mode": "recent", "recent": 5}). effects: visual flourishes; each one is off unless true (smooth_wheel: damped mouse-wheel scrolling on desktop). Editable from the admin panel under 網站設定.
